name: Haloperidol
toxicity: can have serious side effects at higher dosages
risk of having severe extrapyramidal symptoms and muscle rigidity
summary: Haloperidol is a other substance belonging to the Substituted piperidines, Butyrophenone chemical class.

pharmacology.text: Haloperidol is a typical butyrophenone-type antipsychotic that exhibits high-affinity dopamine D2 receptor antagonism and slow receptor dissociation kinetics. It has effects similar to the phenothiazines.

body.says: Biliary (hence in feces) and in urine

uses.text: Haloperidol, sold under the brand name Haldol among others, is a typical antipsychotic medication. Haloperidol is used in the treatment of schizophrenia, tics in Tourette syndrome, mania in bipolar disorder, delirium, agitation, acute psychosis, and hallucinations from alcohol withdrawal. It may be used by mouth or injection into a muscle or a vein.
uses.routes: By mouth, intramuscular, intravenous, depot (as decanoate ester)

summaryZh: 氟哌啶醇以好度等商品名稱於市場上販售，是一種典型抗精神病藥物（又稱第一代抗精神藥物）。用於治療思覺失調症、妥瑞氏症的抽動症狀、雙向障礙的躁狂、譫妄、激動、急性精神病和酒精戒斷症候群引起的幻覺。給藥方式有口服，肌肉注射或是靜脈注射。用藥後通常在30至60分鐘內發生作用。
summaryZhHans: 氟哌啶醇以好度等商品名称于市场上贩售，是一种典型抗精神病药物（又称第一代抗精神药物）。用于治疗思觉失调症、妥瑞氏症的抽动症状、双向障碍的躁狂、谵妄、激动、急性精神病和酒精戒断症候群引起的幻觉。给药方式有口服，肌肉注射或是静脉注射。用药后通常在30至60分钟内发生作用。
